item.description: arXiv:2611.05640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a continuous monthly Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) index for Poland spanning January 2000 to June 2026, following the newspaper-based Baker-Bloom-Davis (BBD) methodology. item.title: A general technique for explicit quantile representations
item.description: arXiv:2611.06459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work proves existence of contours independent of probability level for exact quantile integrals of strictly positive real-analytic densities. Explicit constructions cover five broad distribution families and yield a finite-interval representation of Black-Scholes implied volatility using forward functions.

item.description: arXiv:2611.06888v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work.
